name: CSlate Config Panel
description: System configuration panel for CSlate. Configures the LLM model routed through Vercel AI Gateway (BYOK), visual theme, and server connection. This is a protected system component — users cannot modify it through the AI chat.

llmModel.description: Current LLM model ID in gateway format (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6', 'minimax/minimax-m2.5')

llmApiKey.description: User's own LLM provider API key (BYOK). Stored encrypted via safeStorage. Displayed masked in UI.

gatewayUrl.description: Vercel AI Gateway URL. Defaults to hosted gateway.

isOpen.description: Whether the config panel is visible

llmModel.description: Updated LLM model ID after save

llmApiKey.description: Updated LLM API key after save

theme.description: Updated theme after save — host applies data-theme attribute to document

config:saved.description: Fired when user saves configuration. Host should persist via config:set IPC.

config:closed.description: Fired when user closes the panel

files.role: Main config panel render — sections for AI model, theme, server
Config form state management, validation, and model preset data
TypeScript interfaces for config data and component props
